name: bob-config-importer
description: Import IBM Bob modes, skills, and supporting configurations from a bob_config_collection (public GitHub repository, bundled, or local) into a workspace's .bob/ folder.

enumDescriptions: Download the collection from a public GitHub repository (latest).
Use the collection packaged into this extension version (offline).
Use a bob_config_collection folder on disk.
bobConfigImporter.source.description: Where modes, skills, and other configurations are imported from.

bobConfigImporter.githubRepository.description: Public GitHub repository (owner/name) that contains the collection. Point this at your own repository created from the template.

bobConfigImporter.githubRef.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA to import from.

bobConfigImporter.githubCollectionPath.description: Folder inside the repository that contains modes/ and skills/.

bobConfigImporter.localCollectionPath.description: Collection folder for source 'local': absolute, or relative to the first workspace folder (default: bob_config_collection).

scripts.package: npm run build && vsce package --out dist/
